create_automation: create a new automation with an rrule schedule and validate the recurrence rule
list_automations: list all automations for a user with optional query filter and pagination support
update_automation: update an existing automation by id with a new rrule schedule and validate limits
toggle_automation: toggle an automation on or off by id and recalculate the next run time
run_automation: trigger an automation execution immediately by id and return the enriched automation response
